name: Cloudflare Tunnel
summary: Publish a file, a folder or a local port under a public Cloudflare address.
description: Serves a file or folder from a small local web server, or takes a port you already run, and exposes it with the Cloudflare Tunnel connector (cloudflared) you installed. Tunnels keep running while Vektor runs and always stop when Vektor quits or the plugin is turned off.

groups.title: cloudflared
groups.description: The Cloudflare Tunnel connector this plugin runs. It is yours: Vektor never installs it.

groups.title: Default Settings
groups.description: These settings are used when creating new tunnels.

items.label: cloudflared location
items.help: Leave empty to find cloudflared on your PATH and in the usual Homebrew folders.

items.label: Tunnel name prefix
items.help: Names a tunnel published by port when you leave its name empty.

items.label: Additional arguments
items.help: Passed to every cloudflared this plugin starts.

items.label: Local file server port
items.help: The first port tried for a published file or folder; the next free one is used when it is taken.

items.label: Cloudflare API token
items.help: Kept in your keychain. Quick tunnels need none.
